idea: Build a small autonomous robot that can navigate a room using ultrasonic sensors

roadmapTasks.title: Assemble chassis and mount motors
roadmapTasks.description: Attach DC motors to the chassis plate, secure wheels, and verify free rotation.

roadmapTasks.title: Wire motor driver to Arduino
roadmapTasks.description: Connect L298N motor driver to Arduino digital pins and motor terminals.

roadmapTasks.title: Install power supply
roadmapTasks.description: Mount battery pack, wire to motor driver VCC and Arduino VIN.

roadmapTasks.title: Upload basic motor test code
roadmapTasks.description: Write and upload Arduino sketch to test forward/backward/turn.

roadmapTasks.title: Final assembly and test drive
roadmapTasks.description: Secure all wiring, close chassis, and perform full mobility test.
